name: Conflict Serializability / Precedence Graph

name: Recoverable / Cascadeless / Strict and Rollback
recognitionClueHinglish: Schedule me abort/commit hai; recoverable hai ya nahi, ya kaunse transactions rollback honge.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Kaun kis se dirty read karta hai dekho.
2. Reader ka commit writer ke baad hai kya.
3. Abort par cascading rollback list banao.
variationsObserved: Kaunse transactions cascade me rollback honge.
commonTraps: Cascadeless aur recoverable ko ek maan lena.

whatShouldComeToMind: 2PL phases aur protocol guarantees ki table.
generalSolvingApproach: 3. Protocol properties yaad se match karo.
